page.content:
Late-ripening red that leads Médoc blends and Napa prestige bottles.

How Cabernet Sauvignon connects

  • Item: Vitis vinifera — Cabernet Sauvignon is a Vitis vinifera variety.
  • Location: Bordeaux — Cabernet Sauvignon leads the great Left Bank Bordeaux blends.
  • Location: Napa Valley — Cabernet Sauvignon is Napa's prestige variety.

What is Cabernet Sauvignon?

Cabernet Sauvignon is the Bordeaux Left Bank and Napa building block: structure, cassis, and oak that tasting notes never tire of.

Key threads lead to Vitis vinifera, Bordeaux and Napa Valley.
